---
title: "凸五边形面积归一化第一 Dirichlet 特征值"
lang: zh-CN
---

::: {#thm-main-convex-pentagon-dirichlet .theorem .goal name="Global Dirichlet minimum among equal-area convex pentagons" date="2026-09-20" export="thm-main-convex-pentagon-dirichlet"}
For every $A>0$ and every bounded open convex pentagon $P\subset\mathbb R^2$
of area $A$, let $R_A$ be a regular pentagon of area $A$. Then
$$
\lambda_1(P)\geq\lambda_1(R_A),
$$
where
$$
\lambda_1(\Omega)=
\inf_{0\ne u\in H^1_0(\Omega)}
\frac{\int_\Omega|\nabla u|^2}{\int_\Omega u^2}
$$
is the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of $-\Delta$.
:::
